notes.title: EPSTEIN 2 Released! EPSTEIN 1 Big Update !
notes.notes:
[b]New Update[/b]: September 6: Double Threat! EPSTEIN's Big Update and the Horror-Filled EPSTEIN 2 Release on the Same Date!

[b]Epstein 2[/b]: Dive into the Depths of a Single-Player Horror Story!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839404/4f5156388e4b81a495097676f3cdc9e16f21aae3.png[/img]

Epstein 2 pulls you into a hair-raising story. As Detective Michael, you will step onto the dark and mysterious Epstein Island, where your mother was kidnapped. While tracking her down, you will uncover secrets that challenge the limits of the human mind. With increasing tension and uncertainty at every step, this single-player horror adventure will keep you on the edge of your seat. Epstein 2 offers a masterful blend of fear and narrative.

Epstein 2 will be released in full on [b]September 6[/b]. Prepare yourself for this date, and get ready to solve the mystery and face the dark side of fear!

Hello dear players!

With Epstein's exciting new update, another mysterious island has been added to the 8 enigmatic ones! Along with this update, a new boss who collaborates with Epstein has joined the game: [b]BALL GATES[/b]. On this new island, dark secrets are revealed, and it's discovered that people are being morbidly transformed through horrific experiments. Our main character embarks on this terrifying journey, overcoming all challenges to finally face and defeat Ball Gates. Get ready because the tension and adventure in Epstein have never been deeper!

We hope these updates make your gaming experience richer and more thrilling. Your feedback is very valuable to us, so please don't hesitate to share your thoughts. We wish you all happy gaming!

notes.title: Important Announcement About Bitcoin Mining!
notes.notes:
Bad news for those who thought Bitcoin mining was present in our game: No, we haven't been working on optimization! 😊 Jokes aside, we're intensely tackling the optimization issues within the game. Dynamic changes can sometimes lead to unexpected problems. Nevertheless, our optimization efforts are proceeding at full throttle, and every stage of our game undergoes careful testing and evaluation by Steam. Our Performance Improvement Efforts are in full swing, and rest assured, we are definitely not engaging in any Bitcoin mining.

We understand that "good things take time." Bearing this in mind, we are steadfast in our commitment to enhance the game's performance. We're infinitely grateful for your patience and understanding!

We absolutely adore your sense of humor and are thrilled to be on this journey together with you. Keep following us for more updates, announcements, and beyond.

Best regards

notes.title: Epstein Big Update 2.0
notes.notes:
New Update: Discovery of the Mysterious Islands

Hello dear players!

In the past few weeks, based on the feedback we received from you, we have worked intensively to add new content to our game, Epstein, and to fix existing issues. Today, we want to share with you the significant updates we've made during this process and the modifications inspired by our community's valuable members.

Highlighted Updates:

Bug Fixes: Issues such as glitches and item disappearances have been resolved. A smoother gaming experience awaits you.
Major Fixes:

Physical Interactions: Improvements have been made on the physical interactions within the game, offering a more realistic experience.
Interactive Items: Work has been done on interactive items and their physical responses, enhancing the game's realism.
Exciting Innovations:

Sonic Radar: The "Sonic Radar" feature has been added to ease gameplay. By pressing the "Q" key, you can easily detect collectible items and enemies vulnerable to attack around your character.
Mysterious Islands: Eight new and enigmatic islands await discovery. Filled with mysteries, you will collect equipment on these islands, reach the final island of Epstein, battle tough bosses, and lose yourself in our deepening story.

In Pursuit of a Dark Secret:
Our lawyer friend has secretly infiltrated the island to uncover a dark secret threatening humanity. However, if we lose contact with him, it becomes our mission to unravel this mystery and save the island's people.

With these updates, we hope to enrich and excite your gaming experience. Your feedback is very important to us, so please don't hesitate to share your thoughts with us. We wish you all enjoyable gaming!

notes.title: March 22th Big Update: Epstein Island - The Adrenosoft Mystery!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839404/e2ecf84c3f09fe148e2b6317772fea20a13831a2.png[/img]

Hello adventurers!

As we step by step advance in the gaming world, we're thrilled to share with you the biggest update to our "Epstein" game. The update will be live on March 22th.

In this update, we've fixed many of the bugs found by our community. The map is completely changing and being set into a story.

New Islands, New Adventures:
Eight new and mysterious islands await discovery. In these islands filled with mysteries, you'll gather equipment, reach the game's final island, Epstein Island, battle tough bosses, and lose yourself in our deepening story.

Pursuing the Dark Secret:
Our lawyer friend has secretly infiltrated the island to expose a dark secret threatening humanity. However, if we lose contact with him, it becomes our mission to solve this mystery and save the island's inhabitants.

Be ready for surprises and the update on March 22th!

Galaxyverse Dev Team.

notes.title: ▼Frequently Asked Questions about Epstein▼
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839404/afb7ee78d2c8111dfe1a53a5915e9f09a3e9cec6.png[/img]

We wanted to create an announcement to answer your questions as we have only a few days left to eradicate the bosses on Epstein Island!

Q: Will Epstein be released on the promised date?
A: Yes, the game will be released on February 16th.

Q: Why does Epstein exist as a game?
A: We don't like the bosses in the game, so we wanted to express that in our own way!

Q: How many people are on your team?
A: Our team consists of 3 people, and we are gaining experience with the game gradually (over the past year).

Q: Will the game continue to be developed after release?
A: Yes, we will regularly update the game. We are open to new ideas based on community feedback!

Q: Will there be in-game purchases?
A: No, there are no in-game purchases and there won't be any!

Q: Are there fun Easter eggs in the game?
A: Yes, after building a base with your friends on the island, you can find strange things during exploration.

We appreciate your interest in Epstein and thank you. For the heroes who understand and eagerly await the purpose and description of the game, there are only 6 days left.

Thanks,
Epstein Development Team

notes.title: The Epstein Game can now be played with your friend in multiplayer mode!
notes.notes:
Epstein will be fully available on Steam in February. We are advancing the release of the multiplayer version of the game based on your requests in the community group, and now the game can be played in its complete multiplayer form!

Gather your friends and solve the puzzles on Epstein Island while defeating the bosses together. You can also increase the game's difficulty by setting up your own bases and competing against each other with your friends.


Features:

Build and Upgrade Your Base:

Strengthen yourself on the island by building your own base. Enhance your home and character with new weapons and mechanics you learn, becoming even stronger!

Fish, Breed Animals, and Produce Meat. Survive!:

As you develop yourself on the island, your character will get hungry. You can fish by making a rod and using worms from the soil as bait with a shovel. Build a farm for pigs and chickens, feeding them with their favorite fruits to produce meat. Be careful! Don't forget to cook the meats.

Find the Temple's Code and Defeat the Boss!

Find the code to the temple guarded by the Morbids (Morbid: Grotesque skeletons that feed on human blood). Catch Jefry in the temple and do what needs to be done!
